xsd:element.name: PublishingStartDate
xsd:element.ma:description: Scheduling Start Date is a site column created by the Publishing feature. It is used to specify the date and time on which this page will first appear to site visitors.

xsd:element.name: PublishingExpirationDate
xsd:element.ma:description: Scheduling End Date is a site column created by the Publishing feature. It is used to specify the date and time on which this page will no longer appear to site visitors.

xsd:annotation.xsd:documentation: This value indicates the number of saves or revisions. The application is responsible for updating this value after each revision.
